locations.name: Bakery & Café
locations.description: Red-roofed bakery and café with a striped awning; bake-offs and open-mic nights happen here.

locations.name: Your cottage
locations.description: The player cottage; bought decorations appear in its decorSlots.

locations.name: Town Square
locations.description: Oval sandy square with a fountain, benches and two market stalls; the usual place for events.

locations.name: Farm
locations.description: Fenced vegetable field with a shed and a well; gate on the east side.

locations.name: Pond Park
locations.description: Small park around a lily pond, with blossom trees and a bench.

locations.name: Laude's house
locations.description: Grey-walled cottage with an ochre roof on the bakery road.

locations.name: Post Office
locations.description: Laude's blue-roofed post office; the crow Quill lives on the roof and the Keep cupboard is inside.

locations.name: Notice board
locations.description: Roofed cork board in front of the post office where anyone can pin a notice.

locations.name: Franzi's house
locations.description: Rose-roofed cottage right next to the post office.

locations.name: Penguin enclosure
locations.description: Fenced penguin enclosure; visitors watch from the path.

locations.name: Ferris wheel
locations.description: Ferris wheel with eight coloured gondolas, a favourite for dates at sunset.

locations.name: Carousel
locations.description: Striped carousel under a round canopy.

locations.name: Burger Joint
locations.description: Burger joint with a yellow-and-red awning and parasol tables; burgers come from the farm.

locations.name: Ice cream truck
locations.description: Pink ice cream truck with a cone on the roof.

locations.name: Ice cream truck
locations.description: Pink ice cream truck with a cone on the roof.

locations.name: Cow pasture
locations.description: Large fenced cow pasture with room for more than ten cows; gate on the farm lane.

locations.name: Sheep pasture
locations.description: Fenced sheep pasture; gate on the farm lane.

locations.name: Chicken coop
locations.description: Muddy chicken yard with a little coop; eggs are collected at the coop.

locations.name: Farmhouse
locations.description: Farm office and farm shop counter (a workplace, not a home).

locations.name: Barn
locations.description: Big red barn: the farmer's workplace, where the cheese is made.

locations.name: Butcher
locations.description: Small shed by the east-west road where animals leave the farm (off-screen).

locations.name: Market Road
locations.description: Road from the town to the station with market stalls and spare plots for new shops.

locations.name: Hotel
locations.description: Three-storey hotel for train guests; the lobby leads to six rooms.

locations.name: Train Station
locations.description: Station building and a long platform; trains arrive from the east edge and leave to the west.

locations.name: Whisper Woods
locations.description: Dense mixed forest with trails, a lake and a grove; deer, rabbits, squirrels, hedgehogs, foxes and birds live here.

locations.name: Forest lake
locations.description: Still lake with reeds, lily pads, a duck house and a little jetty; walkable shore along the south trail.

locations.name: The grove
locations.description: Sunny clearing around an ancient tree ringed by standing stones; picnic table and campfire.
